We drive the all-new Audi Q3, the most important launch for Audi in India in a decade, to find out if it can win back ground against the BMW X1, Mercedes-Benz GLA and Mini Countryman.
Audi once sat at the top of India’s luxury car market. Dieselgate, the end of diesels in India, COVID and a slow product cycle changed that, and the brand fell behind its German rivals. The Q3 has always been one of Audi’s best sellers in India, and this new one has to bring the numbers back.
